questions.text: Will you add a kitchen or bathroom?
questions.help: This adds a kitchen or bathroom layout to your checklist.

questions.text: Will you remove or change a wall, beam or post that holds up the house?

requirements.label: Project description
requirements.plainLanguage: A short written description of the basement work: the new rooms and any plumbing, walls or structural changes.

details.label: Basement project description
details.whereToAdd: Project description: list every room and change in the basement.

requirements.label: Basement floor plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A drawing of the whole basement from above, showing the new layout and the existing features you are building around.

details.label: Room names
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: label each room (for example bedroom, bathroom).

details.label: Window dimensions
details.missingMessage: Bedroom window information is incomplete. Add the window dimensions to the floor plan.
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: write the width x height next to each window, especially in bedrooms.

details.label: Door sizes
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: write the size next to each door.

details.label: Kitchen or bathroom layout
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: draw the fixtures (toilet, sink, shower, appliances).

details.label: Stairs location
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: show where the stairs are.

details.label: Furnace location
details.missingMessage: Furnace location is missing. Identify the furnace on the basement plan.
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: draw and label the furnace.

details.label: New wall construction
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: label new walls and note their construction (for example 2x4 studs at 16 in).

details.label: Existing ducting or overhead beams
details.missingMessage: Existing overhead construction is not identified. Show the location of the existing overhead beam.
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan: show existing beams and ductwork overhead (dashed lines are fine).

details.label: Basement ceiling height
details.missingMessage: Ceiling height is missing. Show the basement ceiling height on the drawing.
details.whereToAdd: Basement floor plan or a section: write the finished ceiling height.
